rule: Seeded opening: when the randomize-quests option is on, a seed removes one quest from each of five pools, so runs differ but a seed replays exactly. A towner row is present only while its quest is neither unavailable nor done. XP award scales by level difference in 10 percent steps and is clamped at zero; the level loop then runs while XP is past the next threshold. On death in single player, the kept gold is halved and the dropped half is placed on the death tile, which can be clicked to recover it.

data_fields.name: xp_per_level_step
data_fields.unit: fraction of base XP per level difference

data_fields.name: xp_zero_level_gap
data_fields.unit: levels below which XP is zero

data_fields.name: death_gold_drop_fraction
data_fields.unit: percent of gold dropped on the death tile

data_fields.name: town_presence_gate
data_fields.unit: quest states that hide a towner
